bibliography.title: TimeRewarder: Learning Dense Reward from Passive Videos via Frame-wise Temporal Distance

A.2. Human Video Datasets for Cross-Domain Experiments
A.3. Additional Proof: Boundlessness of VIP Objective

abstract_sentences.text: Designing dense rewards is crucial for reinforcement learning (RL), yet in robotics it often demands extensive manual effort and lacks scalability.

evidence.anchor: dense rewards ... demands extensive manual effort and lacks scalability

abstract_sentences.text: One promising solution is to view task progress as a dense reward signal, as it quantifies the degree to which actions advance the system toward task completion over time.

evidence.anchor: view task progress as a dense reward signal

abstract_sentences.text: We present TimeRewarder, a simple yet effective reward learning method that derives progress estimation signals from passive videos, including robot demonstrations and human videos, by modeling temporal distances between frame pairs.

evidence.anchor: derives progress estimation signals from passive videos

abstract_sentences.text: We then demonstrate how TimeRewarder can supply step-wise proxy rewards to guide reinforcement learning.

evidence.anchor: supply step-wise proxy rewards to guide reinforcement learning

abstract_sentences.text: In our comprehensive experiments on ten challenging Meta-World tasks, we show that TimeRewarder dramatically improves RL for sparse-reward tasks, achieving nearly perfect success in 9/10 tasks with only 200,000 environment interactions per task.

evidence.anchor: nearly perfect success in 9/10 tasks with only 200,000 environment interactions

abstract_sentences.text: This approach outperforms previous methods and even the manually designed environment dense reward on both the final success rate and sample efficiency.

evidence.anchor: outperforms previous methods ... on final success rate and sample efficiency

abstract_sentences.text: Moreover, we show that TimeRewarder can exploit real-world human videos, highlighting its potential as a scalable approach to rich reward signals from diverse video sources.

evidence.anchor: exploit real-world human videos

method_moves.move: define_component：按 P(Δ)∝1/Δ 加权采样短帧距，同时保留长时程覆盖。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把专家视频中有序帧对的 signed temporal distance 变成相邻帧 dense proxy reward；反向距离识别回退，短距采样和 two-hot 维持局部精度，进而指导 sparse-reward RL。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 MDP/observation 问题、Eq. (3)–(7) 的训练到 rollout 链、Eq. (8)–(11) 理论动机、五个 Question、主图和主消融。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 完整任务与 human-video 图集、VIP boundlessness proof、α/backbone/scratch/OT/no-sparse/K/跨域/PROGRESSOR/ManiSkill3 检验、替代模型、初始化协议和超参数进入 Appendix；迁移保留主线，但减少逐任务数字和复现边界。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 4 用 partial-success/visually similar failure 对照，Figure 8 将每个组件映射到任务曲线，Eq. (3)–(7) 将标签、离散化和 rollout reward 串成短链。
final_judgment.largest_gap: Figure 6 没有逐任务终点表、显著性或机制分解；超过手工 dense reward 的 pre-contact 归因没有独立反事实检验，跨域只有 3 个任务，history 输入也没有实证。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 从 passive video 学 dense reward 时，同时监督 forward/reverse frame pairs，并用直接 component ablation 检验负方向是否识别失败；不能只报告成功专家上的单调性。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合单帧大致识别 task phase、视觉 aliasing 较少的有限时域任务；频繁 back-and-forth 或仅 proxy 预算不足时，需要 history/memory 或额外 sparse signal。
